title: Study Vibe rebrand + bilingual (EN/HI) UI + subject illustrations

requirements.summary: Rename all visible branding and page metadata from “Study Vibes Class 9” to “Study Vibe”.
acceptanceCriteria: Header branding text displays “Study Vibe” instead of “Study Vibes Class 9”.
The browser tab/title (frontend/index.html) is updated to “Study Vibe”.
Any remaining visible occurrences of “Study Vibes Class 9” in the UI are updated to “Study Vibe” (excluding image filenames unless explicitly changed).

file_operations.description: Update the HTML document <title> to “Study Vibe” and ensure metadata remains consistent with the renamed branding.
Update header brand text to “Study Vibe” and adjust any user-visible branding strings (including image alt text for logo/hero if present) to reflect the rename.

requirements.summary: Add Hindi translations for all subject titles and summaries and provide an in-app language toggle that switches the entire page between English and Hindi.
acceptanceCriteria: A language toggle is available in the UI (e.g., in the header) with English and Hindi options.
When Hindi is selected, each subject card shows Hindi title and Hindi content for the same subject, and the quick-jump navigation labels reflect the selected language.
When English is selected, the current English titles/content remain available exactly as before.
No subject is missing a Hindi translation (titles and content) for: Mathematics, Science, Social Science, Hindi, Sanskrit, Computer Application, English.

file_operations.description: Extend the subject content model to include both English and Hindi for each subject (titles + summary content), preserving the existing English text exactly as-is while adding complete Hindi equivalents for all seven subjects.

Add a global language state (English/Hindi) and wire it to: header navigation labels, quick-jump buttons, subject card titles, subject content, and any other visible labels on the page. Use the shadcn-ui component set (e.g., a ToggleGroup/Select/Button variant from the existing library) to render the language control in the header. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add and display one subject-specific illustrative image per subject in a consistent, responsive subject card layout with language-aware alt text.
acceptanceCriteria: Each subject card displays its own illustrative image loaded from static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.
There are 7 distinct subject images (one per subject), and they visually differ to match the subject theme.
Images are sized/cropped consistently across cards and do not break the grid layout on mobile/tablet/desktop.
Images include appropriate alt text that follows the selected language (English alt text in English mode; Hindi alt text in Hindi mode).

file_operations.description: Add the generated Mathematics illustrative image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/subject-mathematics.dim_768x512.png and ensure it is suitable for responsive card display.
Add the generated Science illustrative image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/subject-science.dim_768x512.png and ensure it is suitable for responsive card display.
Add the generated Social Science illustrative image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/subject-social-science.dim_768x512.png and ensure it is suitable for responsive card display.
Add the generated Hindi illustrative image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/subject-hindi.dim_768x512.png and ensure it is suitable for responsive card display.
Add the generated Sanskrit illustrative image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/subject-sanskrit.dim_768x512.png and ensure it is suitable for responsive card display.
Add the generated Computer Application illustrative image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/subject-computer-application.dim_768x512.png and ensure it is suitable for responsive card display.
Add the generated English illustrative image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/subject-english.dim_768x512.png and ensure it is suitable for responsive card display.
Add a stable mapping from each subject to its illustrative image filename (under frontend/public/assets/generated/) and provide English/Hindi alt text strings per subject for use by the UI.

Render each subject’s illustrative image within the subject card using a consistent responsive layout (e.g., fixed aspect ratio, object-fit cropping) and wire alt text to the selected language (English/Hindi). Ensure images use the exact generated asset paths under frontend/public/assets/generated/.

requirements.summary: Update existing generated branding images to match “Study Vibe” while keeping correct static asset references in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: The logo and hero/banner visuals are updated to match the “Study Vibe” branding (while keeping the app’s warm academic theme).
frontend/src/App.tsx continues to load the logo and hero images from /assets/generated/ and they render correctly in header/hero.
No broken image links are present in the header or hero sections.

file_operations.description: Update the existing generated logo image content to reflect “Study Vibe” branding while keeping the same filename (frontend/public/assets/generated/study-vibes-logo.dim_512x512.png).
Update the existing generated hero/banner image content to reflect “Study Vibe” branding while keeping the same filename (frontend/public/assets/generated/study-vibes-hero.dim_1600x600.png).
Verify header/hero still reference the correct /assets/generated/ filenames and adjust any related copy/alt text to “Study Vibe” to avoid broken links or mismatched branding.
